source.title: 60 Minute Full Body Dumbbell Strength Workout [With Audio Cues]

notes: 60 s grid: 40 s work + 20 s rest, 60 s after every tenth move (5 groups × 5 moves × 2 rounds). Timer in a dashed ring top left, counting down; the name only on the NEXT / UP FIRST screens (caption under the picture) in the rest before the move. Expected derived from the countdown: each move starts at its 39 (±1 s); names from those screens. Warm-up (Arm Circles + five moves, 30 s each) and cool-down (Snow Angels + four, 30 s each) have no names on screen: only Arm Circles and Snow Angels are labelled, the rest is null (not scored).
